  (let loop ((qs qs) (d 1))

name: prog-meta-eval

(define (lookup-var name env)
  (let ((p (assoc name env)))
    (if p (cdr p) (error "meta: unbound" name))))
(define (meval e env)
  (cond ((number? e) e)
        ((symbol? e) (lookup-var e env))
        ((eq? (car e) 'add) (+ (meval (cadr e) env) (meval (caddr e) env)))
        ((eq? (car e) 'mul) (* (meval (cadr e) env) (meval (caddr e) env)))
        ((eq? (car e) 'let1)
         (meval (caddr e) (cons (cons (car (cadr e)) (meval (cadr (cadr e)) env)) env)))
        (else (error "meta: bad expr" e))))

name: prog-bank-closures
stdin:
(define (make-account balance)
  (define (withdraw amt)
    (if (> amt balance) (error "insufficient funds:" balance amt)
        (begin (set! balance (- balance amt)) balance)))
  (define (deposit amt) (set! balance (+ balance amt)) balance)
  (lambda (msg . args)
    (cond ((eq? msg 'withdraw) (apply withdraw args))
          ((eq? msg 'deposit) (apply deposit args))
          ((eq? msg 'balance) balance)
          (else (error "unknown message" msg)))))
(define acc (make-account 100))
